cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Find any customer's virtual card, check its balance and freeze it when something looks wrong.
cards.searchPlaceholder: Search owner email, card label or last 4 digits
cards.emptyHint: Cards appear here as soon as customers create them.
cards.terminatedNotice: This card was terminated by its owner. Termination is permanent, so it can't be frozen or unfrozen.
cards.frozenByUserHint: The customer froze this card and can unfreeze it themselves. Lock it as an admin freeze if they shouldn't be able to.
cards.frozenByAdminHint: Only an admin can lift this freeze. The customer can't unfreeze it from the app.
cards.frozenBySchemeHint: Frozen automatically when its scheme was disabled. Re-enabling the scheme can lift it, or you can unfreeze this card on its own.
cards.reasonHint: Kept on the card and in the audit log.
cards.freezeBody: Every payment on this card will be declined until an admin unfreezes it.
cards.escalateBody: The customer froze this card. Turning it into an admin freeze means they can no longer unfreeze it themselves.
cards.freezeEffectNotify: The customer is notified straight away.
cards.freezeEffectLock: Only an admin can lift the freeze.
cards.freezeEffectAudit: The action and reason are recorded in the audit trail.
cards.freezeReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Suspected fraud reported by the customer
cards.freezeSuccess: Card frozen. The customer has been notified.
cards.unfreezeBody: Payments will be allowed again straight away and the customer will be notified.
cards.unfreezeSchemeWarning: This card's scheme may still be disabled. Unfreezing lets this card spend while new cards on the scheme stay blocked.
cards.issuerWalletIntro: Compare our ledger with the card's live wallet at the issuer, so you know their dashboard shows the right balance.
cards.issuerWalletHint: Reads the live balance from the issuer each time you check.
cards.issuerWalletUsdHint: Only NGN cards are mirrored at the issuer. USD wallets aren't kept in sync, so a difference here is expected.
cards.noActivityHint: No payment attempts in this range. Try a wider date range.
cards.noJobsHint: Sync jobs are queued whenever this card's ledger changes.
cards.noIssuesHint: Our records and the issuer's agree for this card.

cardActivity.title: Payment activity
cardActivity.description: Every approved and declined card authorization across the platform, newest first.
cardActivity.emptyHint: Nothing matches these filters in this date range. Widen the range or remove a filter.

cardOverview.description: Card platform health at a glance. Figures refresh every minute.
cardOverview.fundsHeldHint: All card balances: what we owe customers.
cardOverview.allClearBody: No open high-risk reconciliation issues, no failed wallet syncs and every scheme is on.
cardOverview.highIssuesBody: The issuer may have paid out without the customer's card being charged.
cardOverview.otherIssuesBody: Amount differences and records missing at the issuer to review.
cardOverview.failedJobsBody: These exhausted their retries, so the issuer's dashboard may show the wrong balance.
cardOverview.schemesDisabledBody: Customers can't create new cards on these schemes.

merchants.title: Merchants
merchants.description: The catalog customers lock their cards to, and the merchants real payments have met.
merchants.uncoveredNotice: {count} merchant names seen in the last 30 days aren't in the catalog. Cards locked to a catalog merchant will decline them.
merchants.emptyHint: Add merchants customers can lock a card to, or start from the Discover tab.
merchants.name: Name
merchants.deactivateBody: It stops matching payments immediately and disappears from the list customers choose from.
merchants.deactivateWarning: Cards already locked to this merchant will start declining its payments.
merchants.deactivateSlugNote: To bring it back later, reactivate it with its slug:
merchants.reactivateBody: Deactivated merchants are hidden from the catalog. Enter the slug of the merchant to bring back.
merchants.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Can't be changed later.
merchants.patternsHint: Text the merchant name on the card statement contains, e.g. NETFLIX. Press Enter to add each one. Matching ignores case and punctuation.
merchants.patternsReplaceHint: Leave empty to keep the current patterns. Anything you add here replaces all of them.
merchants.mccHint: Exact 4-digit codes. When set, a payment must also have one of these categories, which blocks look-alike merchants.
merchants.editNotice: Changes apply to matching immediately, including cards already locked to this merchant.
merchants.errorName: Enter a name of at least 2 characters.
merchants.errorSlug: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
merchants.errorCategory: Enter a category of at least 2 characters.
merchants.errorPatternsRequired: Add at least one statement pattern.
merchants.errorPatternShort: A pattern needs at least 4 letters or digits.
merchants.discoverIntro: The issuer has no merchant directory, so this list learns from real traffic: every merchant name seen on card payments, busiest first. Add the ones customers will want to lock cards to.
merchants.allCoveredHint: Each merchant name from recent payments already matches a catalog entry.
merchants.uncoveredNoticeOne: 1 merchant name seen in the last 30 days isn't in the catalog. Cards locked to a catalog merchant will decline it.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Where our payment log and the card issuer's records disagree. Investigate each issue, then resolve it with a note.
reconciliation.runBody: Compare our authorization log with the issuer's records for a date range. Each disagreement is recorded as an issue.
reconciliation.runHint: UTC dates, up to 31 days. Payments from the last 2 minutes are skipped because they may still be in flight.
reconciliation.rangeFuture: The end date can't be in the future.
reconciliation.rangeReversed: The start date must be on or before the end date.
reconciliation.rangeTooLong: A run can cover at most 31 days.
reconciliation.runningBody: Checking {from} to {to}. New issues appear here as they're found; this list refreshes automatically.
reconciliation.meaningMissingLocally: The issuer approved a payment we never decided on (e.g. auto-approved after a timeout). The customer's card was not charged.
reconciliation.meaningStatusMismatch: We and the issuer disagree on whether this payment was approved or declined.
reconciliation.meaningAmountMismatch: Both sides approved the payment, but the amounts differ.
reconciliation.meaningMissingAtSudo: We approved a payment the issuer has no record of. Usually test data or a lost issuer record.
reconciliation.actionMissingLocally: Money left the issuer's settlement account. Investigate, charge or refund the customer as appropriate, then resolve with a note.
reconciliation.actionStatusMismatch: If the issuer approved and we declined, money may have left without the card being charged. Investigate, correct the ledger, then resolve with a note.
reconciliation.actionAmountMismatch: Check for fees or FX differences, then resolve with a note.
reconciliation.actionMissingAtSudo: Confirm it's test data or a lost record, then resolve with a note.
reconciliation.allClearHint: Our records match the issuer's for every range checked so far.
reconciliation.resolutionNote: What did you do about it?
reconciliation.resolutionNoteHint: Kept on the record and in the audit trail.
reconciliation.resolutionNotePlaceholder: e.g. Confirmed test payment posted to our webhook directly. Not a leak.

walletSync.title: Wallet sync
walletSync.description: Every ledger change moves money in the card's wallet at the issuer so their dashboard matches ours. Jobs normally finish within seconds and retry on their own.
walletSync.runStarted: Sync pass started. The list refreshes for the next 30 seconds.
walletSync.healthFailedBody: They exhausted their retries, so the issuer's dashboard may show the wrong balance for those cards. The error on each job says why.
walletSync.healthOkBody: Every wallet move has either completed or is still retrying automatically.
walletSync.ngnOnly: Only NGN cards are mirrored at the issuer.
walletSync.kindSweepOutHint: Wallet to settlement, after a payment
walletSync.kindSweepInHint: Settlement to wallet, after a refund
walletSync.emptyHint: Jobs appear here whenever a card is funded, spends or is refunded.

schemes.title: Card schemes
schemes.description: Switch card networks on or off. Turning one off stops new cards on it; existing cards keep working unless you freeze them too.
schemes.cardDescription: Turn Verve, AfriGo, Visa and Mastercard on or off for new cards, and freeze existing cards in bulk if needed.
schemes.issuerControlledHint: Cards of this product are funded and controlled by the issuer, so spending rules and top-ups through us aren't available.
schemes.disableBody: Customers will get an error if they try to create a new card on this scheme. Every admin is notified.
schemes.reasonHint: Shown on this page and kept in the audit log.
schemes.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Issuer outage on this network
schemes.freezeExisting: Also freeze every active card on this scheme
schemes.freezeExistingCount: Also freeze the {count} active cards on this scheme
schemes.freezeExistingHint: Runs in the background. Each customer is notified and can't unfreeze the card themselves.
schemes.freezingInBackground: Freezing active {name} cards in the background. Card counts will update shortly.
schemes.enableBody: Customers will be able to create new cards on this scheme again.
schemes.unfreezeFrozen: Unfreeze cards frozen when this scheme was disabled
schemes.unfreezeFrozenHint: Cards frozen by customers or by an admin stay frozen.
schemes.frozenOnScheme: {count} cards on this scheme are frozen right now (all freeze types).
schemes.unfreezingInBackground: Unfreezing {name} cards in the background. Card counts will update shortly.
schemes.freezeExistingCountOne: Also freeze the 1 active card on this scheme
schemes.frozenOnSchemeOne: 1 card on this scheme is frozen right now (all freeze types).
